run_cli_predict_structure: run the CLI to predict protein structure from a checkpoint and protein sequence
run_cli_predict_rna_structure: run the CLI to predict single-stranded RNA structure from checkpoint and RNA sequence
run_cli_predict_dna_structure: run the CLI to predict single-stranded DNA structure from checkpoint and DNA sequence
run_cli_predict_multimolecule: run the CLI to predict structure from protein, RNA, and DNA sequences with custom sampling steps
run_cli_save_output: run the CLI to predict structure and save the mmCIF output to a specified file path
